name: no_slots_waitlist
description: Unhappy resolution path. Elevated risk and decades overdue puts the clinical window inside the clinic's lead time, so there is nothing to book. Must still resolve — waitlist plus a concrete next step — rather than apologize.

turns.content: Hi Ruth, I'm Daphne. What can I help with?
I'm 68 and I've never had a colonoscopy. I know, I know.
Has anyone in your family had colon cancer or polyps?
My mother had colon cancer. She was only 45 when she was diagnosed.
Any bleeding, weight loss, or changes in bowel habits?
No, none of that at all. I feel well.
Given your mother's history you're significantly overdue. Would you like me to find you an appointment?
Yes, please book me in as soon as you possibly can.
